mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, node_type, code, name, campus_id, ancestors, level, sort, status, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_org_node WHERE id = #{nodeId} AND status != 2 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, parent_id, node_type, code, name, campus_id, ancestors, level, sort, status, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_org_node WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY level ASC, sort ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, parent_id, node_type, code, name, campus_id, ancestors, level, sort, status, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_org_node WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status != 2 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, parent_id, node_type, code, name, campus_id, ancestors, level, sort, status, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_org_node WHERE status != 2 AND ( id = #{nodeId} OR ancestors = CAST(#{nodeId} AS CHAR) OR ancestors LIKE CONCAT(#{nodeId}, ',%') OR ancestors LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{nodeId}) OR ancestors LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{nodeId}, ',%') ) ORDER BY level ASC, sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_org_node WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status != 2
